notes.title: Wardens of Chaos
notes.content: Gather a party of four adventurers and explore the Lands of Alsinar, a fantasy realm offering multiple key missions and side quests. Battle vicious monsters, discover powerful artifacts, and seek help from allies to destroy those in your way. Take vengeance on enemies who razed your home city and unravel the evil plot behind the land's troubles.
